control_objective: Receive complete authentic balance records from an authoritative source by an approved cutoff
risk_addressed: Late missing stale or unauthenticated balances create an unreliable enterprise position
proposed_control_activity: Maintain an expected account-day schedule; authenticate the source; capture source receipt timestamp approved cutoff balance type owner and record status; retain late or missing records in the denominator and exception log
evidence_required: Expected-population control total; source authentication; receipt timestamp; cutoff comparison; exception owner and resolution
design_status: Proposed; current dataset has reporting dates but no receipt timestamps or approved cutoff
stop_or_rollback_trigger: No authoritative source owner controlled denominator or approved cutoff before launch

control_objective: Ensure the enterprise position is complete reconciled versioned and decision-useful
risk_addressed: Unexplained breaks or inconsistent balance definitions produce unsafe funding decisions
proposed_control_activity: Reconcile source records to the position by account entity currency value date and balance type; classify every expected record as reconciled or formally explained; require approval for material breaks and definition changes
proposed_operator: Treasury operations with IT/Data and Regional Finance
evidence_required: Control totals; reconciliation results; break log; materiality rule; approver; position version
design_status: Proposed; materiality tolerance and controlled baseline are not approved
stop_or_rollback_trigger: Defined material unexplained break; changed definition without decision-log approval

control_objective: Prevent estimated or locally required balances from being treated as transferable cash
risk_addressed: Cash movement or value is approved without restriction buffer settlement legal tax service or economics evidence
proposed_control_activity: Maintain account-level certification of restriction operating buffer local settlement requirements transfer timing permitted action economics effective date owner and review date; uncertified value contributes zero to funded mobility
frequency_or_trigger: Before mobility value or movement decision and on certification expiry
proposed_operator: Regional Finance with Legal/Tax and Finance input
evidence_required: Current certification; source evidence; approvals; buffer rationale; permitted action; review date
design_status: Proposed; validated movable cash remains zero established
stop_or_rollback_trigger: Missing expired or disputed certification; local service or specialist objection

control_objective: Ensure funding instructions are authorized segregated and within approved limits
risk_addressed: Unauthorized inaccurate or poorly evidenced transfer or funding instruction
proposed_control_activity: Require documented rationale amount entity timing authority independent approval and local feasibility attestation before instruction; link the instruction to the approved daily position
proposed_operator: Authorized Treasury and Regional/Local Finance operators
evidence_required: Decision record; delegated authority; initiator and approver; local attestation; linked position; instruction
design_status: Proposed; approval limits and authority matrix require confirmation
stop_or_rollback_trigger: Failed authority segregation local-right control or service test

control_objective: Confirm an approved funding action is executed recorded and reconciled
risk_addressed: Instruction outcome is unknown or disconnected from accounting and the next position
proposed_control_activity: Capture bank acknowledgement status or settlement evidence accounting reference exception and final reconciliation; prevent an unresolved item from being silently treated as complete
proposed_operator: Authorized local operator with Treasury operations
evidence_required: Bank acknowledgement; status/settlement evidence; accounting entry; reconciliation; exception closure
design_status: Proposed; no transfer or facility-use records are supplied
stop_or_rollback_trigger: Missing acknowledgement; unresolved material status; accounting mismatch

control_objective: Protect critical obligations and local service through a controlled emergency funding path
risk_addressed: Central coordination or outage delays payroll tax refunds critical suppliers or regulated obligations
proposed_control_activity: Define criticality delegated emergency limits dual approval or approved compensating control contingency channel immediate notification full evidence capture post-event reconciliation and next-business-day review
frequency_or_trigger: Approved emergency trigger or continuity event
proposed_accountable_owner: Relevant BU or Regional Finance owner
evidence_required: Criticality and rationale; authority; approvals; execution confirmation; compensating control; post-event review
design_status: Proposed; local emergency rights limits and evidence require approval and testing
stop_or_rollback_trigger: Critical service failure; unapproved bypass; inability to restore the approved process within four hours
source_basis: DP-03; DP-06; stakeholder local-autonomy and service concerns

control_objective: Ensure each payment request is authorized complete and traceable to source evidence
risk_addressed: Incomplete invoice beneficiary entity or purpose data creates rework error or fraud exposure
proposed_control_activity: Require approved intake fields and source documentation; validate requestor authority and master-data linkage; return or reason-code incomplete requests rather than silently completing them
proposed_accountable_owner: BU Finance or business process owner
proposed_operator: Authorized requestor with Shared Services validation
evidence_required: Source document; required-field check; requestor authority; beneficiary and entity reference; exception reason
design_status: Proposed; required source fields and documents are not supplied
stop_or_rollback_trigger: No source document authorized requestor or required critical field

control_objective: Apply approved calendars cutoffs criticality and local service rules consistently
risk_addressed: Late release or an inappropriate standard route threatens service continuity
proposed_control_activity: Classify due date criticality approved cutoff local calendar and exception path before approval; route urgent items through the controlled emergency process
frequency_or_trigger: Each payment request and calendar change
proposed_operator: Shared Services with BU/Regional Finance input
evidence_required: Timestamp; approved cutoff; criticality; local calendar; exception or emergency approval
design_status: Proposed; timestamp baseline and critical-service definition are TBD
stop_or_rollback_trigger: Critical payment risk; unapproved late or emergency classification; peak blackout conflict

control_objective: Maintain delegated authority segregation of duties and complete approval evidence
risk_addressed: Unauthorized or conflicted initiation approval release or repair
proposed_control_activity: Enforce role separation approval limits independent approval and immutable change history across request file release repair and resubmission; define approved compensating control for emergency cases
evidence_required: User roles; approval matrix; initiator and approver; timestamps; change history; compensating control if used
design_status: Proposed; current approval practices vary and control effectiveness is untested

control_objective: Prevent duplicate prohibited invalid or misdirected payments before release
risk_addressed: Duplicate sanctions beneficiary or master-data failure causes loss compliance or service harm
proposed_control_activity: Apply duplicate beneficiary sanctions required-master and amount/currency validations using approved systems and escalation rules; evidence the result before release
evidence_required: Validation results; exceptions; override authority and rationale; approval evidence
design_status: Proposed; tool rules tolerance and current evidence require specialist confirmation
stop_or_rollback_trigger: Confirmed control failure or unapproved override

control_objective: Ensure the approved request reconciles to the secure bank submission and acknowledgement
risk_addressed: Format transmission or control-total failure creates rejection delay or duplicate submission
proposed_control_activity: Reconcile source-to-file count and value; use an approved format and secure channel; capture bank acknowledgement; control retries and contingency submissions
evidence_required: Source-to-file control totals; format validation; secure transmission log; acknowledgement; retry history
design_status: Proposed; source population and value are not certified
stop_or_rollback_trigger: Unreconciled file absent acknowledgement transmission compromise or uncontrolled retry

control_objective: Ensure each exception repair and resubmission is reason-coded owned approved and resolved
risk_addressed: Silent recycling obscures cause duplicates approval changes and capacity evidence
proposed_control_activity: Record status reason root-cause category owner repair action timestamps approval resubmission and final outcome; review aged items and corrective actions by mutually exclusive cohort
frequency_or_trigger: Each exception and periodic backlog review
proposed_operator: Shared Services with requestor IT and bank support
evidence_required: Reason code; source link; owner; action; approval; timestamps; outcome; aged-item review
design_status: Proposed; reason codes events criticality and source links are not supplied
stop_or_rollback_trigger: Critical/control exception; missing approval; source documents or required events cannot be linked

control_objective: Preserve local responsiveness without creating an uncontrolled bypass
risk_addressed: Urgent critical payment is delayed or emergency use weakens authorization and auditability
proposed_control_activity: Limit emergency use to defined critical events; require delegated authority dual approval or approved compensating control secure channel confirmation immediate notification and post-event reconciliation/root-cause review
proposed_operator: Authorized local operator approver and Shared Services
evidence_required: Criticality; rationale; authority; approvals; submission and confirmation; compensating control; review
design_status: Proposed; procedure limits channels and tests require owner approval
stop_or_rollback_trigger: No authorized approver or channel; control breach; critical service failure

control_objective: Limit access to authorized users and recertify privileges for standard and contingency processes
risk_addressed: Excessive stale or conflicting access enables unauthorized action or weakens SoD
proposed_control_activity: Maintain role-based least privilege joiner-mover-leaver control privileged-access monitoring and periodic management recertification; include emergency and fallback access
frequency_or_trigger: On access change and at approved periodic cadence
proposed_operator: IT access administration with business/control owner approval
evidence_required: Access request and approval; role mapping; SoD result; recertification; exception and remediation
design_status: Proposed; inconsistent recertification is a stakeholder observation and test evidence is absent
stop_or_rollback_trigger: Unauthorized access failed recertification unresolved toxic combination or privileged misuse

control_objective: Ensure interfaces changes and data mappings are secure reconciled tested reversible and retirement-aware
risk_addressed: Integration defect cyber weakness or deep investment in a retiring ERP creates operational failure or rework
proposed_control_activity: Apply architecture cybersecurity change test and release approval; reconcile source-to-target records; test failure modes; document legacy transition dependency and exit path
frequency_or_trigger: Each material interface mapping or release change
proposed_operator: Architecture IT/Data Cybersecurity and process owner
evidence_required: Approved design; threat/control review; test and reconciliation; release approval; dependency and exit plan
design_status: Proposed; no platform vendor or final architecture selected
stop_or_rollback_trigger: Failed cyber architecture data reconciliation or required-control test; unapproved peak-period change

control_objective: Restore the approved prior service within the proposed four-hour standard and preserve evidence
risk_addressed: Change or outage disrupts critical cash or payment service and cannot be safely reversed
proposed_control_activity: Define monitoring incident authority backup/fallback process rollback steps data reconciliation communications and rehearsal; prohibit scale without successful test
frequency_or_trigger: Before launch after material change and on qualifying incident
proposed_operator: IT operations and business process owner
evidence_required: Continuity plan; rollback runbook; rehearsal timestamp and result; restored-data reconciliation; incident review
design_status: Proposed; four-hour gate is a design hypothesis and no rehearsal evidence is supplied
stop_or_rollback_trigger: Critical service/control incident or inability to restore within four hours

control_objective: Keep KPI populations definitions denominators and evidence traceable and comparable
risk_addressed: Definition drift unsupported extrapolation or incomplete lineage misleads decisions
proposed_control_activity: Maintain a metric contract with source grain denominator period formula exclusions evidence label limitation owner refresh and version; require decision-log approval before a definition changes
frequency_or_trigger: Before baseline and each reporting cycle or definition change
proposed_operator: Data owner and analyst or reporting operator
evidence_required: Metric contract; source reconciliation; calculation output; version; approval; change log
design_status: Proposed; current supplied-extract proxies are not controlled enterprise baselines
stop_or_rollback_trigger: Unreconciled population changed denominator missing owner or unsupported extrapolation
specialist_review: Data governance; Finance for benefit metrics

control_objective: Preserve explicit local rights while preventing permanent informal workarounds
risk_addressed: Global standard ignores local need or local exception becomes an ungoverned default
proposed_control_activity: Record each exception with policy requirement local rationale evidence approving owner scope control effective date review or expiry and exit condition; report overdue exceptions
proposed_operator: Regional Finance or BU Finance requestor
evidence_required: Exception record; evidence; approval; compensating control; review date; closure
design_status: Proposed; local-right boundaries and approval levels require confirmation
stop_or_rollback_trigger: Unapproved expired or control-deficient exception; critical local service risk
source_basis: DP-03; APAC and BU stakeholder concerns

control_objective: Prevent unvalidated value or uncosted commitments from funding or scaling a change
risk_addressed: Screening outputs or management estimates are treated as realized value or the FY2026 ceiling is treated as a cost estimate or spending authority
proposed_control_activity: Keep cash release annual P&L capacity and risk separate; require reconciled baseline formula scenario low/base/high cost timing dependency client owner validation action and Finance approval; require the combined initial stage to fit the $1.0–$1.5m FY2026 ceiling or return for staged approval; record unquantified benefits separately
frequency_or_trigger: Each benefit line and every funding or scale decision
proposed_operator: Benefit owner with Finance validation; CFO/SteerCo decides funding and scale
evidence_required: Baseline; formula; source; scenario; cost range; timing; owner; realization evidence; envelope check; Finance approval
design_status: Proposed; mobility capacity account-fee receivables and FX value remain excluded from funded case and implementation cost is TBD
stop_or_rollback_trigger: Benefit without source reconciliation owner realized-value formula cost or Finance approval; uncosted scope; initial stage above ceiling without staged approval
source_basis: F08; F10; F11; DP-02; DP-08; W2 funded-value rule; start-of-Week-3 CFO update
